population: Adult male tennis players. Clinical limits are general-population adult (male 20-44 where CDC data exist; otherwise AAOS-style reference values, sex-unspecific). Tennis-specific values live only in each joint's athleteNotes and never widen minDeg/maxDeg.

convention.zero: Anatomical position = 0 deg for every motion (va_38cfr_471), except shoulder rotation (zero at 90 deg abduction, elbow 90 deg, forearm vertical) and forearm pronation/supination (zero = elbow 90 deg at side, thumb up).
convention.sign: Each axis is a signed range [minDeg, maxDeg]. Positive = the motion named in that axis's 'positive' field: flexion, abduction, external rotation, pronation, ulnar deviation, dorsiflexion, inversion; left lateral flexion/rotation for spine rows (mirror for the other side is symmetric). The opposite motion is negative, so extension/hyperextension, adduction, internal rotation, supination, radial deviation, plantarflexion and eversion appear as negative minDeg.
convention.sides: Values apply to both left and right sides; mirror for the left limb so that 'positive' keeps its anatomical meaning.
convention.limitsAre: Passive clinical end range (CDC values are population means of passive end range). Not dynamic peaks; dynamic serve peaks are in athleteNotes.
convention.labels: SOURCED = number appears at the cited URL at 'where'; ESTIMATED = reasoning in 'reason'; null = value unknown, reason in 'note'.
